---
title: "tvbo config"
---

View the user-level CLI configuration. Configuration writing is scheduled for milestone C2; today the verb is read-only.

## Synopsis

```text
tvbo config path
tvbo config show
```

## Resolution rules

The config file is located at:

```text
${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/tvbo/config.toml
```

`XDG_CONFIG_HOME` honours the [XDG Base Directory specification](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/basedir-spec/) when set.

## Sub-commands

### `tvbo config path`

Print the resolved path. Useful in shell pipelines, e.g.:

```bash
$EDITOR "$(tvbo config path)"
```

### `tvbo config show`

Print the file contents. Prints `# (no config at <path>)` to `stderr` and exits `0` if the file is missing.

## Roadmap

The C2 milestone will add:

- `tvbo config set KEY=VALUE`: write into the user file
- `tvbo config get KEY`: read a single value
- Profile support for multiple HPC clusters and multiple credential sets

Until then, edit the TOML file by hand.
